label: Manages
blurb: Manager → report: assigns, decides, and reviews down; receives escalations and status up.

label: Serves
blurb: Provider → requester: receives requests as tickets and reports resolution back. The requester may be an external actor.

label: Oversees
blurb: Reviewer → subject: the subject submits an artifact; the reviewer returns an independent verdict that may gate progression.

label: Consults
blurb: Asker ↔ expert: a lateral advisory dialogue; the expert's opinion is non-binding.

label: Peers
blurb: Peer ↔ peer: lateral coordination against shared contracts (planning-time seams, not runtime blocking).

label: Stewards
blurb: Owner → resource: the steward is the only position that changes the shared resource; others request changes through it.

label: Iterates
blurb: Auditor ⟳ subject: a standing feedback loop — the auditor raises findings, the subject revises, repeat until it converges. The one archetype that DELIBERATELY closes a cycle, for experimental optimize/validate loops (not a dependency hazard).
